missions.title: Record Trace
missions.description: We tried to look for ways to make amends, but to no avail. And so we've been ordered to drop all investigations...

missions.title: Emergency Reinforcement
missions.description: HQ keeps sending us trivial missions. Guess that means we're back to our daily routine...

missions.title: Enemy Investigation
missions.description: We repulsed yet another Sangvis guerilla attack. But it's all for naught if HQ doesn't order us to go on the offensive.

missions.title: Data Collection
missions.description: Persica from 16LAB sent a sudden request for us to collect data under heavy crossfire. Does everyone just let her do as she pleases...?

missions.title: Additional Commission
missions.description: Persica still wanted to boss us around. Thank goodness HQ finally ordered us to resume our operation. We can finally return to the battlefield!

missions.title: Termination
missions.description: We defeated Executioner and rendezvoused with Elite T-Doll M4A1 of the AR Team. So she's...the one Sangvis Ferri is after?

missions.title: Field Samples I
missions.description: The Commander has accepted Persica's request to collect parts of Sangvis units as samples for experiment.

missions.title: Field Samples II
missions.description: Persica doesn't seem keen on contacting M4A1, even though she'd given us all sorts of aid off the record in finding her...

missions.title: Field Samples III
missions.description: M4A1 got in touch with Persica her and dispelled Persica's sense of guilt for issuing her previous request. It's nice that she no longer feels burdened.

missions.title: Field Samples IV
missions.description: We've fulfilled Persica's request, but initial analysis reveals great differences between the technologies behind Sangvis and Grifon T-Dolls. How on earth did Sangvis Ferri come to be?

missions.title: Professional Help I
missions.description: We provided cover for Thompson's squad to reach their bases. They're gonna assist the military in suppressing rioting armored machines.

missions.title: Professional Help II
missions.description: Thompson managed to put every unruly T-Doll demurely in their place - such tact!

missions.title: Professional Help III
missions.description: The military messed up our plan by advancing the operation, but we always have an ace up our sleeve...

missions.title: Professional Help IV
missions.description: We snatched the data from the control room, and the military could say nothing about that... Mission accomplished - small revenge also accomplished.
